health.hero.title: The parent platform behind every Asclepios product.
health.hero.lead: Asclepios Health is the platform. Asclepios Sleep is its first pathway — a guided sleep programme — with more health pathways on the way.
health.platform.title: One platform. Focused health pathways.
health.platform.body: Asclepios Health brings together real products, guided digital pathways, and plain-language education under one platform. Each pathway — starting with Sleep — stands on its own, backed by the same platform underneath.
health.platform.pillar1.title: Guided pathways
health.platform.pillar1.body: Each Asclepios pathway pairs a focused routine with an app to help you follow it.
health.platform.pillar2.title: Real products
health.platform.pillar2.body: Physical products designed to work alongside the digital programme, not instead of it.
health.platform.pillar3.title: Plain-language education
health.platform.pillar3.body: Content grounded in evidence and written for everyday reading, not clinical jargon.
health.solutions.title: Start with Asclepios Sleep
health.card.sleep.title: Asclepios Sleep
health.card.sleep.body: A guided sleep programme: routine, sound, and morning review, tailored to you.
health.card.recovery.title: Recovery & Nutrition
health.card.recovery.body: A future Asclepios Health pathway for everyday recovery and nutrition, currently in development.
health.card.wellness.title: Everyday Wellness
health.card.wellness.body: A future Asclepios Health pathway for everyday wellness habits, currently in development.
health.learn.title: Sleep science and everyday health, explained simply.
health.learn.body: Layered articles and guidance back every Asclepios pathway. Sleep education is available today inside Asclepios Sleep.
health.member.title: Already an Asclepios member?
health.member.body: Sign in to Asclepios Sleep to pick up your routine, review your progress, and manage your account.
health.footer.tagline: The parent platform behind every Asclepios product.
